- 3 In the next window, you can choose between IBM SKLM or Gemalto SefeNet KeySecure server types, as shown in Figure 12-42. Select Gemalto SefeNet KeySecure and click Next.
- 4 Add up to four SafeNet KeySecure servers in the next wizard window, as shown in Figure 12-43 on page 638. For each server, enter the name; IP address and TCP port for KMIP protocol (default value is 5696). Note that server name is only a label, so it does not need to be the real host name of the server. key

Figure 12-42 Selecting Gemalto SafeNet KeySecure as server type key

<!-- image -->

Although Gemalto SafeNet KeySecure uses an active-active clustered model; IBM Spectrum Virtualize asks for a primary server. The primary key server represents only the KeySecure server that is used for key create and rekey operations. Therefore; any of the clustered servers can be selected as the primary . key key

Selecting a primary server is beneficial for load balancing. Any four servers can be used to retrieve the master key key key.
